name: VideoWare
description: Self-contained web based video editor. Upload media, create clips, edit timelines, and collaborate with other users on the same project in real time.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent storage: PocketBase database, uploaded media, and the Redis queue.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the web app, PocketBase API and admin (proxied by nginx on container port 80).

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Email for the auto-created PocketBase superuser.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the auto-created PocketBase superuser. MUST be set to a strong value - leaving it at the default skips superuser creation.

variables.name: Storage Type
variables.description: Storage backend: 'local' (files under /data) or 's3'. For 's3' you must also supply the STORAGE_S3_* variables (see README).

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging verbosity: error, warn, info, debug, verbose.
